en: Black‑and‑white postcard image showing a Gothic stone niche inside a church or cathedral. In the niche stands a bearded male saint holding a circular shield or medallion with a lamb, likely the Agnus Dei. Below the statue is a panel of five slender Gothic arches with small columns and carved capitals. The masonry and tracery are richly detailed and characteristic of medieval European Gothic church architecture.
